validity.summary: GEM researcher notes flag P3990/P3991/P3992 as a 'should these be combined' question. Evidence gathered on this pass supports treating P3991 and P3992 as DISTINCT physical objects (not duplicates of each other): federal decree 816-r/1378-r item 266 (government.ru/docs/all/101903/?page=14) and Komi's 2021-2025 gasification-programme listing (Wayback capture of gazprommap.ru/komi/, 2022-07-19) both list 'Gazoprovod-otvod k GRS Vizinga' (7,500 m3/h = 0.18 mill.Sm3/day, matching P3992's recorded Capacity) as a SEPARATE programme item from the Vylgort-Pazhga otvod feeding GRS with a DIFFERENT stated capacity (10,000 m3/h = 0.24 mill.Sm3/day, matching P3991's recorded Capacity) at a different point in the same list. Different GRS destinations, different capacities, different route segments (this row: Syktyvdinsky district Pazhga/Yb settlements through Sysolsky district Kunib/Vizinga/Mezhador; P3991 per its own name runs Vylgort-Pazhga, a different district pairing) all corroborate two physically distinct otvody sharing a common corridor/anchor point (Pazhga village, which sits at the junction — P3991 terminates there, P3992 originates there), not one pipeline double-counted. I could NOT determine P3990's identity/relationship in the time available (searched the same federal decree page and the Komi programme list; no object in reach clearly maps to a 'P3990' name/description) - see cross_row_lead for P3990. RECOMMENDATION: do not merge P3991 and P3992; they are sequential, distinct otvody sharing the Pazhga node. P3990 remains an open question for whoever holds that row.

validity.summary: GEM currently records PipelineType='distribution' for this row. Per this sweep's own classification test, a row named '<X> - GRS <Y>' is the otvod (branch) feeding INTO the GRS from the upstream/trunk side, i.e. transmission, not the downstream distribution network the GRS itself feeds onward. Supporting facts found: (1) the federal decree calls the object a 'gazoprovod-otvod k GRS Vizinga' (a trunk-side branch TO a gas distribution station, not the distribution network past it); (2) the entity carrying out construction, per the operator's own Apr 2025 disclosure, is Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta - a Transgaz (interregional gas TRANSMISSION) subsidiary, not a Gazoraspredeleniye (regional gas DISTRIBUTION) company, which is the operator class that would normally build/own true distribution mains. Both facts point toward transmission, not distribution, for this specific segment (the otvod itself) - though the GRS's own downstream village mains (separately being built per bnkomi.ru/189920, Sysolsky district) ARE genuinely distribution and this concern does not apply to those. NOT overwriting PipelineType directly since no source uses the literal word 'transmission' - flagging via contested per the task's instruction not to silently reclassify.

ГРС "Пажга" и "Визинга" с подачей газа в 2025 году и вводом в 2026 году' — construction of GRS Pazhga+Vizinga (this отвод's destination stations) explicitly underway as of Apr 2025.

fills.researcher_notes: Sheet Status=proposed (LastUpdated 2023-07-25) is stale. Two dated, differently-sourced statements postdating LastUpdated show real progress: (1) Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta's own general director, in the operator's Apr 10 2025 year-end report (komiinform.ru/279170), states construction of GRS Pazhga+Vizinga (the отвод's endpoint) is underway ('ведется строительство'), gas supply targeted 2025, formal commissioning ('ввод в эксплуатацию') targeted 2026. (2) Komi government/PMEF press recaps dated Jun 2025 and Jun 2026 (pg11.ru/145090; komiinform.ru/296317 — near-identical boilerplate text repeated a year apart, treated as one press-office origin, not counted as a second independent confirmation) say the five отводы including Пажга and Визинга were 'построены' (built/constructed). Given the operator's own more specific and technical Apr-2025 statement puts formal commissioning in 2026 (i.e. still future at that date), I am NOT proposing 'operating' — that would overstate. 'construction' is the best-supported current status: physical construction is confirmed underway/largely complete, but the operator itself had not yet called it commissioned as of its most recent dated statement. See also bnkomi.ru/141870 (2022-03-21): the original 2022-2031 regional programme item for this отвод targeted completion 2024 — consistent with a project that started construction on schedule and is now in its final stage. Also checked bnkomi.ru/189920 (2025-09-17): downstream village distribution network construction in Sysolsky district (incl. Vizinga village itself) is still ongoing with a district-wide target of end-2026 — this is normal (trunk отвод+ГРС is built first, then downstream mains extend to villages over following years) and does not contradict the отвод's own construction/near-completion status.

verifications.note: Federal decree 816-р item 266 (as amended 1378-р 27.05.2023): 'производительность ГРС - 7,5 тыс. куб. метров в час' = 7,500 m3/h x 24h = 180,000 m3/day = 0.18 million Sm3/day — matches the sheet's CapacityUnits=mill.Sm3/day exactly, no unit conversion error. Note the decree ALSO states 'проектный объем транспортировки газа - 16,8 млн. куб. метров в год' (16.8 million m3/YEAR, an average annual planned throughput figure) — this is a DIFFERENT metric (annual average flow, ≈0.046 mill Sm3/day) from the GRS nameplate/design capacity (7.5 thousand m3/h = 0.18 mill Sm3/day); GEM's 0.18 matches the nameplate capacity, not the annual-average figure, and I am citing accordingly rather than conflating the two.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Sheet Status='proposed' (LastUpdated 2023-07-25) is stale by ~2 years relative to available evidence. Chose 'construction' over 'operating' deliberately: the ONE source that specifies a formal commissioning ('ввод в эксплуатацию') year is the operator's own Apr 2025 statement, which puts it in 2026 (future, relative to the statement date) - i.e. as of the operator's own most recent dated disclosure, the object was not yet commissioned. The press claims of 'построены' (built) postdate that operator statement (Jun 2025) but 'built' is a physical-completion milestone, distinct from and earlier than 'commissioned/operating' in this domain's vocabulary, and I judged the two press recaps (Jun 2025, Jun 2026) to be one shared press-office origin rather than two independent confirmations (near-identical wording repeated a year apart is a documented giveaway of common boilerplate, not fresh verification). Net: real, well-evidenced progress since the 2023 'proposed' status, landing on 'construction' as the best-supported non-overstated call, with StartYear1 corrected from the sheet's unsourced 2024 to the operator's stated 2026 target. Downstream village distribution mains in the district (separate from this otvod/GRS pair) are independently confirmed still under construction as of Sep 2025 (bnkomi.ru/189920, district target end-2026), consistent with and not contradicting this timeline.
